name: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker
summary: In Darnassus, Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker gathers reports from the coast. The Ironforge dwarf works outside the Temple of the Moon, where he coordinates the Explorers' League's research and tracks colleagues in Darkshore.

sections.title: A Dwarven Scholar in Darnassus
sections.body: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker works outside the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, far from his home in Ironforge. He represents the Explorers' League, which sent him across the sea to Kalimdor for fieldwork. There, he speaks with night elf scholars such as Tarelvir and seeks knowledge of the ancient lands. In Ironforge, his lectures covered ancient lore and primordial beings, including the Wild God Agamaggan. Now he hopes to learn what the night elves' ancestral lands hold.

sections.title: Eyes on Darkshore
sections.body: In Kalimdor, Greywhisker oversees dwarven excavations and follows expeditions searching ancient coastal ruins. He depends on travelers to carry messages to prospectors across the sea in Darkshore. Field research in unexplored lands is perilous, and he waits anxiously for reports from the dig sites, hoping his colleagues are safe among the ruins.

faq.answer: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker is a dwarven scholar from Ironforge and a representative of the Explorers' League. Outside the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, he coordinates the League's research in northern Kalimdor and speaks with night elf scholars.

faq.q: What is an Ironforge dwarf doing in Darnassus?
aliases: why is a dwarf in darnassus
faq.answer: The Explorers' League sent Greywhisker across the sea to uncover forgotten history and ancient artifacts. He makes scholarly contacts in the night elf capital and oversees dwarven expeditions along Kalimdor's ancient coasts.

faq.q: What is his connection to Agamaggan?
faq.answer: In Ironforge, Greywhisker lectured on ancient history, including the Wild God Agamaggan, a giant boar. His teachings inspired younger prospectors such as Lonebrow to study ancient beast folklore.

faq.q: Who is Greywhisker talking to outside the temple?
faq.answer: Outside the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, Greywhisker speaks with Tarelvir, a night elf scholar. They exchange ideas and coordinate historical research between their peoples.

faq.q: What trouble is he dealing with in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Greywhisker's fellow dwarven researchers are excavating ancient ruins in Darkshore, but isolated expeditions are hard to reach. He seeks couriers to check on absent-minded prospectors and recover their research journals.

faq.q: Which faction does Greywhisker belong to?
faq.answer: Greywhisker belongs to the Explorers' League, an Ironforge archaeological organization devoted to discovering dwarven origins and ancient history. The League is aligned with the Alliance.

angles.text: As a dwarf, seeing one of Ironforge's leading scholars outside the Temple of the Moon recalls your people's drive to uncover ancient history across Kalimdor.
As a night elf, Greywhisker brings the Eastern Kingdoms' new alliance to your city. He speaks with scholars outside Elune's temple about the continent's past.
As an Alliance member, Greywhisker connects Ironforge's Explorers' League with expeditions across northern Kalimdor.
